intent: Map existing VRMs and drive collections to hubzz-ingress readiness.

items.title: Refresh the VRM map: reachability + discovery + readiness + build
items.notes: The deterministic core. Re-runs every iteration; catches VRMs that died or came back, discovers new VRM URLs, re-scores readiness. ~0 tokens.

items.title: Re-host / re-pin the 72 dead VRMs (the #1 readiness blocker)
items.reason: Needs a ruling: where do we re-host? (R2/altii.co like the hubzz pipeline, or pin to a paid IPFS service). This is the biggest lever — 72/74 sets fail vrm_ok only because the file is unreachable.

items.title: Arweave GraphQL sweep for VRM files, validated by the extractor
items.notes: Prototype proved the pipeline (query -> partial-GLB validate). Refine the tag filter: reverse-engineer a known VRM tx's tags (100avatars is on Arweave), then query that convention instead of the noisy model/gltf-binary content-type. Land hits as proposed leads (blocked for human ruling).

items.title: Resolve the 50 unknown/red licenses (license_ok blocker)
items.notes: Second-biggest readiness blocker. Re-assess from embedded VRM meta + external URLs; verify sources for the ones still unknown.

items.title: OpenSea enrichment (banners/pfps/socials/descriptions/stats)
items.notes: RESOLVED: the key is NOT expired. GET /collections/{slug} + /collections list return 200. Fixed 3 real bugs that made it look dead: aiohttp base_url must end in '/' (opensea_client), Cache used under async-with without __aenter__ (enrich_opensea), and enrich_all used the tier-gated POST /collections/batch -> now per-slug GET. OpenSea returns a MISLEADING 'API key has expired' for (a) tier-gated endpoints (batch, per-token /nfts) and (b) unknown slugs. Run `python scripts/enrich_opensea.py --force` to refresh (slow: rate-limited 120/min).

items.title: Merge duplicate rows: vipe-heroes + vipe-heroes-genesis are the same collection
items.reason: Needs a human ruling — merging changes collection identity. Evidence: contract 0x3999877754904d8542ad1845d368fa01a5e6e9a5 is on-chain 'VIPE Heroes' (VPH, totalSupply 3000). Our `vipe-heroes` row holds that contract but no avatars; `vipe-heroes-genesis` holds the 3000 avatars but no contract (so it fails identity_ok). pre-alpha's seed-registry.ts calls the same contract 'VIPE Heroes Genesis'. Decide the surviving id/name, then move avatars + contract onto it.

items.title: Promote per-avatar model_file_url to collections lacking a VRM
items.notes: The avatars table (from the Open Source Avatars registry) already held 4,062 direct model_file_url VRM links while collections were still marked no_url — the on-chain/OpenSea discovery paths never looked there. scripts/promote_avatar_vrm_urls.py validates a candidate and lifts it to the collection. Promoted 3: 100Avatars R1 (arweave), ToxSam (pinata), VIPE Heroes Genesis (dweb.link).

items.title: Fix collections whose opensea_slug is an internal id (e.g. 'retrodogesnft')
items.notes: Some opensea_slug values are our internal collection id, not the real OpenSea slug, so enrichment 401s ('expired') for them. Resolve the true slug via the contract (GET /chain/{chain}/contract/{addr}) or resolve_opensea_collections.py, then re-enrich.

items.title: Enumerate more VRM collections via an indexer (Reservoir/Alchemy/Moralis)
items.reason: Needs an indexer API key ruling. The server uses Moralis; a Reservoir key would let sources/reservoir.py enumerate candidates to feed the discovery loop.

items.title: Propose brand-new VRM collections found by the sweeps
items.reason: Adding a new collection to the catalog needs a human ruling (L1 gate). The loop proposes; the human approves.
